svg.title: Five Ways a Test Can Lie to You
svg.desc: Five panels, each with a tilted scale above a level scale. Different teachers: one teacher's enthusiasm lifts one group; use one teacher for both groups. Different times of day: students are more alert at one time; run both groups at the same time. Extra help: one group gets a review or hints; use the same script and help for both. Different tests: the versions are measured in different ways; use the same test and key for both. Student choice: motivated students choose one version; assign at random.
svg.text: Five Ways a Test Can Lie to You
Before you trust a difference between groups, ask what else was different besides the version.
Tilted scale: a hidden weight tips the comparison. Level scale: the defense makes the groups equal except for the version.
